title: Illness, coming to New Orleans, and first musicians met
summary: Handy fell sick, was operated on at Charity Hospital, stayed with his mother on Carrollton Avenue, worked sanding paint off cars and met Kid Rena, Kid Punch and Buddy Petit but not Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, after then, I'd taken sick.

And I came here with pennies. I just remember the fellow I was working for, but he was from, he was from over the river. And he had a summer home in Long Beach. And I had a girlfriend. And I was with that girlfriend and through that girlfriend, I would go on her job. And I'd taken from there, the doctor taking in with me. I'd do a little days work, a little, in and out once in a while. And they'd taken a liking to me and I fell sick with a penny. Then I came here. They brought me here. They brought me on Tulane. And when they brought me on Tulane, my mother was living here, my mother and my sister, up in Carlton. Then they gave me a note. I wasn't living here. My mother and them was here already. But I wasn't living here. But they gave me a note to go to the Charlie Hospital. Old Charlie. That's where I was operating in. Old Charlie for pennies. I left from there. I went back by my mother and them up in Carlton Avenue. I was there about, about nine weeks. Then I had a job that offered to me. The sand caused down. And at that time, they had a thinner to take all the paint off the cars and make it just sit. Just bring it back to the natural tin. Then we'd take gasoline and wash it down good. Then sand it again. If you didn't sand it good, that the paint would raise and it wouldn't be a good job. So we had to wash it down. Then go over it with vinegar to make everything blend out so it would be a good job. Well during those times I met a lot of musicians such as our Kid Rainy. I met our Kid Punch. I met Buddy Petit.
I didn't meet the greatest man he is now.
Louis Armstrong. I didn't meet him during those times.
I guess he went to Chicago.
